{
  "primary_meaning": "Sacred rest: the Sabbath is most commonly understood as symbolizing participation in God’s own rest, fulfilled spiritually in rest or salvation in Christ and ultimately in eternal or eschatological rest.",
  "primary_basis": [
    "Genesis 2:2–3 — God rests on the seventh day and blesses it.",
    "Exodus 20:8–11 — Sabbath rest is grounded in God’s creation rest.",
    "Matthew 11:28–30 — Jesus offers rest to those who come to him.",
    "Colossians 2:16–17 — Sabbaths are described as a shadow whose substance belongs to Christ.",
    "Hebrews 3:7–4:11 — entry into God’s rest remains available, and a Sabbath-rest remains for God’s people.",
    "Revelation 14:13 — the blessed dead rest from their labors."
  ],
  "alternatives": [
    {
      "meaning": "A continuing creation ordinance and recurring literal seventh-day holy rest, rather than chiefly a symbol displaced by its fulfillment.",
      "basis": [
        "Genesis 2:2–3",
        "Exodus 20:8–11",
        "Isaiah 56:2–7",
        "Mark 2:27–28",
        "Luke 4:16",
        "Acts 13:42–44"
      ],
      "prominence": "common"
    },
    {
      "meaning": "A covenant sign specifically identifying and sanctifying Israel under the Mosaic covenant.",
      "basis": [
        "Exodus 31:12–17",
        "Ezekiel 20:12, 20",
        "Deuteronomy 5:12–15"
      ],
      "prominence": "common"
    },
    {
      "meaning": "A memorial of deliverance from slavery and therefore a sign of liberation, humane treatment, and social justice.",
      "basis": [
        "Deuteronomy 5:12–15",
        "Exodus 23:10–12",
        "Isaiah 58:13–14",
        "Luke 13:10–17"
      ],
      "prominence": "common"
    },
    {
      "meaning": "A pattern transferred to the Christian Lord’s Day, with Sunday commemorating Christ’s resurrection and anticipating the final renewal.",
      "basis": [
        "Matthew 28:1–6",
        "Acts 20:7",
        "1 Corinthians 16:2",
        "Revelation 1:10"
      ],
      "prominence": "common"
    },
    {
      "meaning": "A prophetic type of a future millennial ‘seventh age’ or thousand-year reign.",
      "basis": [
        "Genesis 2:2–3",
        "Psalm 90:4",
        "2 Peter 3:8",
        "Revelation 20:1–6"
      ],
      "prominence": "minority"
    }
  ],
  "has_settled_consensus": false,
  "confidence": "high",
  "notes": "There is broad Christian agreement that rest is the Sabbath’s central symbolic field. There is no fully settled consensus about the referent of that rest: traditions variously emphasize present rest in Christ, future heavenly rest, literal weekly observance, Israel’s covenant sign, liberation, or Sunday/Lord’s Day fulfillment."
}
